mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within 3 months of signal activation, or 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 5% within 6 months of signal activation, or 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPI inflation falls below 2% within 6 months of signal activation, or 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals an aggressive tightening cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS falls below 4% within 3 months of signal activation, or 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the HOUST index, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing starts rise above the prior year's level within 6 months of signal activation, or 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating growth in nonfarm payrolls, as measured by the year-over-year change in PAYEMS, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Nonfarm payrolls decline year-over-year within 6 months of signal activation, or 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real estate loan balances, as measured by the year-over-year change in RSAFS, signals an overextended consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Real estate loan balances decline year-over-year within 6 months of signal activation, or 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the CPI inflation rate above 4% signals an overheating economy that will drive the Fed to aggressively tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPI inflation falls below 3% within 6 months of signal activation, or 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
